messages:
maria (cs): Quick note from onboarding w/ PioneerHealth (PM: Aaron). They requested: 1) ability to toggle embedding routes per-team in the Console; 2) a nightly CSV export showing per-route usage & cost; 3) better error visibility for bulk embedding jobs (they see intermittent 502s). Renewal in 4 weeks so this is high priority.

lee (product): Thanks. Can you capture one example error payload and how they run bulk jobs?

maria (cs): Aaron said they run 20k vectors across 4 jobs; errors are sporadic 502/timeout after ~30s. Sending sample logs to eng. Also asked for a "route off" toggle in Console so their security team can prevent certain teams from using embeddings.

ade (cs): Finance also asked for daily per-route CSV with columns: date, route_id, tokens, cost_usd. They need it for renewal decks.

tess (eng): 502s during bulk ingest often indicate overloaded workers or short-circuiting on fallback. @lee share traces and tenant id; I'll look at batching metrics.

lee (product): Created ticket PH-2002 to track. Short-term: propose enablement doc + export script for finance. Longer-term: per-route toggle as Q2 small project.

ticket-bot: PH-2002 created: pioneerhealth-embed-export-toggle. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PH-2002

maria (cs): I'll update account health to "at-risk" and follow up with Aaron on acceptable workarounds. If they can tolerate a concurrency limit for 4 weeks, renewal likely okay.

ade (cs): I'll draft the CSV export script and the templated email for CSMs.

tess (eng): Investigating now. Posting initial findings to PH-2002.

lee (product): Recap/action: PH-2002 triage (prod+eng), enablement export + email (CS), account health update (CS). Aim to have mitigation note to customer within 48h.
